instruments.grantee: The Marine Midland Trust Company of New York and Baldwin Maull, Trustees
instruments.mortgagee: The Marine Midland Trust Company of New York and Baldwin Maull, Trustees
instruments.other_capacities: Trustees for holders of First Mortgage Sinking Fund Bonds, 4%, Series A, due March 1, 1956
instruments.legal_description_raw: Statewide and multistate mortgage of company real estate, compressor and measuring stations, gas pipe lines, transmission lines, rights-of-way, easements, gas-distribution systems, oil-and-gas leasehold estates and mineral interests, contracts, franchises, equipment, and after-acquired property. The Beckham County rights-of-way schedule includes B. E. Maddoux — N/2 NW/4 of Section 32, Township 11 North, Range 25 West; A. E. Maddoux — S/2 NW/4 of Section 32, Township 11 North, Range 25 West; and G. A. Crook — NE/4 of Section 32, Township 11 North, Range 25 West.
instruments.legal_description_normalized: Pipeline rights-of-way/easements across N/2 NW/4, S/2 NW/4, and NE/4 of Section 32, Township 11 North, Range 25 West
instruments.prior_references: Company deeds, leases, rights-of-way, permits, franchises, and contracts itemized in schedules, including target rights-of-way at B05-G011 through B05-G013.
instruments.subject_to: Secures First Mortgage Sinking Fund Bonds, including 4% Series A bonds due March 1, 1956; trust terms, redemption provisions, and prior property burdens stated in the indenture.
instruments.consideration: $10.00 and other good and valuable consideration
instruments.material_title_notes: Complete replacement for the earlier partial B05-G017 records. The indenture begins on 0223.jpg at Mortgage Book 64 p.507, contains the target Beckham County right-of-way schedule on 0243.jpg, continues through all operative articles in this batch, is executed and sealed on 0330.jpg, and ends with multistate acknowledgments and clerk certification on 0332.jpg at p.617.
instruments.interest_before: Consolidated Gas Utilities Corporation held its operating properties, pipeline and distribution systems, leasehold/mineral interests, contracts, franchises, and easement/right-of-way interests, including the three target Section 32 easements.
instruments.interest_after: Those properties and rights were pledged/mortgaged to the trustees as bond collateral, creating a lien/security conveyance rather than a fee transfer to an operating successor.
instruments.relevance_to_diversified: Directly relevant to the target tract because the mortgage schedule identifies all three Section 32 pipeline-easement tracts. No Diversified party appears, and the instrument alone does not establish succession to Diversified.
instruments.assumptions: Recorded pages are continuous from p.507 on 0223.jpg through p.617 on 0332.jpg. No missing page is apparent within that run.
instruments.full_title: Indenture of Mortgage and Deed of Trust

instruments.grantor: Manufacturers Trust Company and James F. McNamara, Trustees
instruments.releasor: Manufacturers Trust Company and James F. McNamara, Trustees
instruments.other_capacities: Manufacturers Trust Company succeeded Chatham Phenix National Bank and Trust Company as corporate trustee
instruments.legal_description_raw: All properties of whatsoever nature, real, personal or mixed, and all estate, right, title and interest granted, conveyed or assigned under the June 1, 1928 Original Indenture and supplemental indentures recorded across listed Oklahoma, Kansas, and Texas counties, including Beckham County.
instruments.legal_description_normalized: General release of all property and liens under the 1928 mortgage and its supplements; Beckham County included
instruments.prior_references: Indenture of Mortgage dated June 1, 1928 from Consolidated Gas Utilities Co. to Chatham Phenix National Bank and Trust Company and James F. McNamara, Trustees; supplemental indentures dated July 1, 1931, August 31, 1931, October 1, 1935, and November 30, 1935.
instruments.material_title_notes: Releases and discharges the 1928 mortgage trust and all listed supplements after payment of the secured debt. The recitals document the 1932 merger of Chatham Phenix into Manufacturers Trust Company and the 1935 acquisition of the predecessor company's assets by Consolidated Gas Utilities Corporation.
instruments.interest_before: The trustees held mortgage/trust liens on the predecessor utility properties and Consolidated Gas Utilities Corporation held the underlying operating/property interests subject to those liens.
instruments.interest_after: The mortgage/trust liens were satisfied, canceled, released, discharged, and annulled; the released property remained in Consolidated Gas Utilities Corporation.
instruments.relevance_to_diversified: Potentially relevant as lien-release and predecessor-history evidence for utility assets in Beckham County, but the instrument does not identify Section 32 or any Diversified entity and does not prove later succession.
instruments.assumptions: Section 32 relevance is indirect because this release lists counties and source mortgages, not tract-level legal descriptions.
instruments.full_title: General Release of June 1, 1928 Indenture of Mortgage and Supplemental Indentures

instruments.material_title_notes: Quitclaims all of Ethel Malone's right, title, interest, estate, claim, and demand. The form's boilerplate names Washita County, while a typed parenthetical expressly introduces the following Section 32/28 property as situated in Beckham County; that internal county inconsistency requires title review.
instruments.interest_before: Ethel Malone held whatever undivided right, title, interest, estate, claim, or demand she owned in the described tracts; no fraction is stated.
instruments.interest_after: Charlie Crook received Ethel Malone's entire stated interest by quitclaim, without a quantified fraction.
instruments.relevance_to_diversified: Direct Section 32 ownership-chain evidence for the NE/4, but no Diversified party or express mineral/pipeline interest appears.
instruments.assumptions: No ownership fraction was inferred. The typed legal calls control this extraction; the Washita/Beckham county conflict is preserved rather than resolved.

instruments.interest_before: Unknown from the available ending fragment.
instruments.interest_after: M. M. Bennett remained bound by the mortgage covenants described in the ending fragment; the encumbered property and mortgagee are unknown.
instruments.relevance_to_diversified: No defensible Section 32 or Diversified connection can be made from the available fragment.
instruments.assumptions: This is treated as a separate partial instrument because a signature and acknowledgment end before the separately captioned Keathley mortgage begins.

The released Original Indenture includes the Beckham County Section 32 pipeline rights-of-way scheduled in Mortgage Book 64 pp.507-617.

instruments.material_title_notes: Releases, satisfies, cancels, discharges, and annuls the B05-G017 mortgage trust and all listed supplements after payment of all secured indebtedness, interest, and premium. Images 0347-0350 are scoped; overlap-only 0351.jpg was inspected solely to capture signatures, acknowledgments, and the actual p.86 ending and is not counted as reviewed.
instruments.interest_before: The trustees held the mortgage/trust lien created by B05-G017 and its supplements over Consolidated Gas Utilities Corporation's properties, including the scheduled Section 32 easement interests.

instruments.relevance_to_diversified: Directly relevant as release of the target Section 32 pipeline-easement mortgage lien. No Diversified entity appears, and the release does not itself establish later corporate succession or present ownership.
instruments.assumptions: Section 32 linkage derives from the expressly released Original Indenture B05-G017 and its reviewed tract schedule, not from a repeated tract schedule in this release.
instruments.full_title: General Release of March 1, 1941 Indenture and Supplemental Indentures
